get.description: Reads one Project with either a browser Session, a project:read Personal Access Token intersected with the user's live Project role, or a project:read Project Automation Token bound to this exact Project.

post.description: Archives a Project with a browser Session or a project:write Personal Access Token. Origin and X-CSRF-Token are required for browser Session authentication and ignored for non-ambient Bearer authentication. Project Automation Tokens cannot perform lifecycle mutations because audit requires a live human actor.

416.description: Byte ranges are deliberately unsupported for Alpha Project Bundles

post.description: Restores a Project with a browser Session or a project:write Personal Access Token. Origin and X-CSRF-Token are required for browser Session authentication and ignored for non-ambient Bearer authentication. Project Automation Tokens cannot perform lifecycle mutations because audit requires a live human actor.
